scope: Local uncommitted working tree at recorded source hashes; not a hosted rerun or unfamiliar-user acceptance.
head: 937a19b8f821a72dfc46126948394a223d88c55c

preparation_attempts.detail: Candidate venv did not contain Black. Original configured Black formatted the runner; Python syntax and Prettier checks passed. Product dependencies unchanged.

limitations: One local Windows host and two repetitions per fixture; no statistical percentile claim across hosts.
Memory sampled after each window became ready. Startup memory and transient peaks can be missed. Sampling pauses across full desktop restart.
Renderer heartbeat is a timer responsiveness proxy; it is not exhaustive interaction or paint latency.
Source-byte maximum uses whitespace padding. Other import formats, worst-case strings, numeric reference analysis, comparison and evaluation remain unmeasured here.
Actual combined-limit saved cases were 22053390 bytes; 64 MiB case ceiling, large libraries, unsupported disks and multi-hour stability were not measured.
Broader fuzzing and unfamiliar-tester acceptance remain unfinished.
